summary: Re-review of the post-approval delta: DSN extraction is a byte-for-byte pure refactor, the vacuous pragma test is now a load-bearing guard, no public accessor leaked, no coverage lost, limits hold.
notes: contract-check ok=true; violations: none; not_checked: forbid.behaviors (reviewed manually below, unchanged from the prior approved review since this delta touches only DSN construction and test placement).

POINT (a) VERIFIED: construirDSN (outbox.go:120-122) is a pure extraction. Diff shows the exact prior inline fmt.Sprintf("file:%s?_pragma=journal_mode(WAL)&_pragma=synchronous(FULL)&_pragma=busy_timeout(5000)", ruta) line was cut from Abrir and pasted unchanged into the new function; Abrir now calls dsn := construirDSN(ruta) at outbox.go:135. No character of the pragma string changed. Independently re-verified: go build/go vet/go test all exit 0 against the current tree.

POINT (a) FURTHER VERIFIED BY MUTATION: in a throwaway scratch copy (never touching the reviewed worktree), deleting &_pragma=synchronous(FULL) from construirDSN's format string turned TestConstruirDSN_PragmasRequeridos (pragmas_internos_test.go:9) RED, while TestPersistir_ExitosoYDurabilidad kept passing. The new guard is genuinely load-bearing where the old one (asserting PRAGMA synchronous on a second bare sql.DB) was not.

POINT (b) VERIFIED: sidecar/internal/outbox/pragmas_internos_test.go:1 declares 'package outbox' (internal test package, confirmed via file header), and TestAbrir_PragmaJournalModeEnConexionActiva reads ob.db.QueryRow directly (the unexported field), not through any public accessor. Grepped the whole package for an exported *sql.DB accessor or an exported ConstruirDSN symbol: none exists. go doc ./internal/outbox lists only the seven originally intended exported functions (Abrir, Persistir, Pendientes, Confirmar, Purgar, Cerrar plus the unexported construirDSN, which does not appear in go doc output). The public-accessor leak from the intermediate fix was fully removed.

POINT (c) VERIFIED: the outbox_test.go diff vs main shows only TestPragmas_WALYSynchronousFull (34 lines, one flat test function with no subtests) was deleted, no other assertion touched. Reproduced the full suite locally: 41 top-level '^--- PASS' lines now vs 40 before this delta (net +1 = -1 vacuous test + 2 new internal tests), matching the orchestrator's reported count exactly. No test was silently weakened or lost in the relocation.

POINT (d) VERIFIED: total changed files from main including the untracked pragmas_internos_test.go = 6 (ci.yml, go.mod, go.sum, outbox.go, outbox_test.go, pragmas_internos_test.go), within max_files_changed=8. Total diff = 866 insertions / 3 deletions = 869 lines, within max_diff_lines=1600. outbox_test.go alone is 453 lines, within its per_class budget of 700. ci.yml is 4 lines (2+2), within its per_class budget of 12. Ran quorum analyze contract-check with these exact numstat-derived figures: ok=true, violations=[], not_checked=[forbid.behaviors].

All 9 verify.commands re-run fresh against the current working tree (not trusted from 05-validation.json alone): all exit 0, including the CGO_ENABLED=0 build/vet, gofmt -l empty, go test ./... green, and the non-vacuity floor command with -v yielding grep -c '^--- PASS' = 41 (>= 36).

go.mod/go.sum diff reviewed directly: whatsmeow pin unchanged at v0.0.0-20260722203353-e9a033b24933; only modernc.org/sqlite plus its documented transitive indirects were added, matching blueprint step 1's predicted mechanical delta. ci.yml diff is exactly the floor number 12->36 plus its comment, nothing else restructured, matching blueprint step 10.

forbid.behaviors re-checked for this delta specifically: no ADR written, no driver change, pragmas not weakened (confirmed by mutation test above), no per-connection sequence number introduced, no leasing added to reads, retention logic untouched, no out-of-scope A-3 work, no Connect/network in any test, no payload logged, no new logging/ORM/migration/assertion dependency, no database file committed (verified via git status --porcelain filters), all new/changed text in Spanish, no AI attribution in any pending change. None violated.

Everything the prior approved review verified about durability semantics (fsync-first Persistir, id_deduplicacion-keyed Confirmar, secuencia ASC ordering in Pendientes, at-least-once via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, AUTOINCREMENT-based monotonicity, adr-0019 log privacy boundary) is untouched by this delta and was re-spot-checked against the current outbox.go without finding any regression.

Deferred by design and correctly absent: IPC socket server, delivery loop, event translation, whatsmeow wiring, sqlstore integration, cross-process restart test (all in 00-spec.yaml non_goals). docs/STATUS.md gap remains a correct human follow-up since docs/** is in the contract forbid list.

LOW SEVERITY, pre-existing and previously noted, unaffected by this delta and not re-litigated: empty-identifier check ordered before the closed check in Persistir/Confirmar; benign TOCTOU on Cerrar racing an in-flight call; unescaped path interpolation in the DSN. None of these are touched by the three post-approval changes.
